outstanding.finding: receipts contain only an unchecked, nonempty code_rev; no source blob or commit identity is validated, so an endpoint produced under changed source can still be skipped.
outstanding.self_assessment: Correct, and it is the same non-emptiness anti-pattern this lane already recorded as KNOWN_ISSUES #21. validate_endpoint_receipt requires code_rev to be a non-empty string and never compares it to anything, and the receipt records no source blobs at all. A repair must record the producing source blobs in the receipt and compare them, not merely require presence.

outstanding.finding: dirty-source checking accepts `_worktree_blob(...) is None`, so DELETING a bound source passes instead of failing closed.
outstanding.self_assessment: Correct and fail-open. The guard reads `need(_w is None or _c == _w, ...)`; when git hash-object fails on a missing file _w is None and the check passes. The None case must be a blocker, and it must distinguish 'file absent' from 'git unavailable'.

outstanding.finding: candidate containment uses normpath, not resolved repository containment, so /evil/active_universe_5d/standard/candidate/out.root and symlink escapes pass. Separately, the validator calls a PSD residual check a 'full-total identity' without comparing that residual to the bound stat+ML components.
outstanding.self_assessment: Both correct. The component-sequence match succeeds anywhere the sequence appears, including outside the repo, and normpath does not resolve symlinks. Containment must be realpath-based against the repo root. And PSD of (C_combined - C_syst) is NECESSARY but not SUFFICIENT for C_combined = C_syst + C_stat + C_ML: it does not prove the residual EQUALS stat+ML. Naming it a full-total identity overclaimed what was computed.

outstanding.finding: tests still execute neither shell driver nor a builder->validator happy path; source-text assertions are inadequate and incorrectly bless the PSD-residual check as full-total recomputation.
outstanding.self_assessment: Accepted. The shell-driver gap was disclosed in the test file's docstring rather than hidden, but disclosure is not coverage. The test name test_validator_recomputes_the_full_total_identity asserts on source text and inherits the same overclaim as defect 4's second half -- a test that blesses a weaker check under a stronger name is worse than no test, which is the defect-6b family this round was supposed to end.
